issues.description: The problem statement and the template declare that Course.getAverageRating() returns a Double, but the solution implementation defines getAverageRating() to return a Float. This return-type mismatch is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students about the expected API and may cause tests or client code expecting a Double to fail or behave unexpectedly.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type across all artifacts. Change the solution implementation of getAverageRating() to return Double (e.g. func getAverageRating() -> Double) and perform calculations using Double (Double(starSum) / Double(totalRatings)), or alternatively update the problem statement and template to expect Float. Prefer updating the solution to Double to match the current specification and template.
